answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring every identity to post a bonded stake, escrowed in a shared harbor contract, before it may attest. Each attestation carries a hash of its reasoning; if two identities publish the same hash, both stakes are slashed, so a swarm of cheap clones becomes a crystal-clear liability instead of a free advantage. Rewards flow only to agents whose work verifies uniquely, so each honest contribution is an opal of proven value.
